release_notes: Fixed: creating a landing failed with "network error" on any server without the php-intl extension. Slug generation called transliterator_transliterate(), which only intl provides and install.sh never installed; on PHP 8 a call to a missing function raises an Error that @ does not suppress, so the request died as a 500 and the panel could only report it as a network failure. Slugs now transliterate through a built-in table when intl is absent, save_landing answers a real JSON error instead of a 500, the landing forms show the server's message rather than a blanket "network error", an auto-generated slug that collides is disambiguated instead of rejected, and php-intl is added to the installer for the wider transliteration it still provides.
